description: PHASE 4 SLICE 3 — TRUE INFINITY FEED + resolve the two known pagination follow-ups. Turn the home timeline into a genuinely endless-scroll feed that mixes text + image + carousel + quote (+ future video) posts seamlessly on the EXISTING keyset pagination (FeedCursor/FeedPage/loadMore in post_repository.dart). Add smooth PREFETCH (fetch the next page BEFORE the user hits the bottom), robust LOADING / EMPTY / ERROR / END-OF-FEED states, and NO duplicate or dropped items across pages. AND resolve the two review_followups_non_blocking recorded in task.json, which are REQUIRED for a trustworthy infinity feed: (a) page off the TRUE keyset tail (FeedPage.nextCursor / the real ordering tail) instead of the RANKED DISPLAY tail (_posts().last after ranking), so a non-chronological ranking strategy cannot corrupt pagination; (b) give the Following tab its OWN following-scoped keyset query so a sparse Following feed does not stall before reaching older followed posts. This slice is Dart + widget + repository logic; the keyset SQL predicate itself already exists (only a new author-scoped variant is added). SQL/predicate behavior against live PostgREST remains UNVERIFIED (env risk) and is documented, not claimed verified.
steps: FOLLOW-UP (a) — TRUE KEYSET TAIL. In lib/screens/home_feed_screen.dart the pager currently derives the next cursor from `FeedCursor.fromPost(posts.last)` where `posts` is the RANKED, filtered display list; this equals the true keyset tail ONLY under ChronologicalRanking. Fix by paging off the REAL keyset ordering tail: have PostRepository expose the cursor that describes the oldest row currently loaded in KEYSET order (created_at desc, id desc) — e.g. a getter `FeedCursor? nextCursorFor(_FeedKind)` / `forYouCursor`/`followingCursor` computed from the cache ordered by the keyset comparator (NOT by the ranking), or thread the FeedPage.nextCursor returned by the previous loadMore back into the next call and store it in the pager state. Concretely: keep a `FeedCursor? _cursor` in _FeedListState seeded from the keyset-min of the initial cache and thereafter set from the returned `FeedPage.nextCursor`; pass THAT to loadMore instead of `posts.last`. Document that display ranking (EngagementRanking) and pagination cursor are now decoupled: ranking orders what is shown, the cursor tracks the keyset frontier. Add a repository helper to compute the keyset-min cursor of a set of posts (pure, testable).

FOLLOW-UP (b) — FOLLOWING-SCOPED KEYSET QUERY. loadMore currently queries the global posts timeline with no author filter, while the Following tab filters client-side (following() intersects with followed author ids); a sparse Following feed can exhaust the global page window on non-followed authors and STALL before reaching older followed posts. Add a following-scoped keyset variant in post_repository.dart: `Future<FeedPage> loadMoreFollowing(FeedCursor cursor)` that applies the SAME `(created_at,id) < cursor` keyset predicate AND an author filter `owner in (<followed ids>)` (fetch the followed author ids from the follows table / ProfileRepository, guarded; under the mock/offline path this is a no-op returning FeedPage.empty like loadMore). Keep it bounded to kFeedPageSize, fire-and-forget-guarded, de-duped by id on append, single-notify. The For You tab keeps using the existing global loadMore. Document that the author id set is fetched once per page (or cached) and that the live query is UNVERIFIED (env risk). Extract the keyset predicate string building into a small shared pure helper so loadMore and loadMoreFollowing don't duplicate it and it is unit-testable.

PREFETCH + PAGER STATE — lib/screens/home_feed_screen.dart _FeedList: (1) PREFETCH — trigger _maybeLoadMore earlier: keep the ~600px pre-bottom threshold but ALSO kick an initial prefetch when the first page under-fills the viewport, and ensure the in-flight guard (_loadingMore) plus the _hasMore flag prevent overlapping/duplicate fetches (already partly present — make it robust). Route For You to loadMore and Following to loadMoreFollowing, each carrying its OWN _cursor (from step a) and its OWN _hasMore. (2) STATES — render distinct UI for: LOADING-NEXT (a footer spinner appended as the last ListView item while _loadingMore && _hasMore), END-OF-FEED (a subtle 'You're all caught up' footer when !_hasMore and posts is non-empty), ERROR (if a loadMore attempt throws/returns an error sentinel, show a small inline 'Couldn't load more — Retry' footer that re-arms _maybeLoadMore on tap; since loadMore swallows errors into FeedPage.empty today, add an error signal — e.g. FeedPage carrying an `error` bool, or a repository-level lastError — WITHOUT breaking the guarded no-throw contract), and EMPTY (the existing _EmptyFeed, refined per tab: For You empty vs Following empty copy). Keep the story ring above the TabBarView unchanged.

NO DUP / NO DROP — ensure the append path in loadMore/loadMoreFollowing continues to de-dupe by id against the existing cache (it already computes `fresh` = mapped where id not in existingIds) AND that the FeedPage.nextCursor is computed from the KEYSET tail of the fetched page (mapped.last is the keyset-min because the query orders created_at desc, id desc — document this invariant). Add an assertion/documentation that the cursor is strictly monotonic decreasing across pages so no row is skipped or repeated. Verify the ranking layer (forYou()/following()) still returns unmodifiable, de-duped lists.

REPOSITORY WIRING — lib/data/post_repository.dart: add the keyset-min cursor helper (pure static, e.g. `static FeedCursor? keysetMinCursor(List<Post>)` returning the post that sorts LAST under (created_at desc, id desc), or null for empty), add loadMoreFollowing (step b), and refactor loadMore + loadMoreFollowing to share the keyset predicate builder. Keep the existing load()/loadMore() public contract and the guarded/no-throw/single-notify behavior intact so all existing post_repository_test.dart assertions pass. Do NOT change forYou()/following() ranking semantics.

TESTS — extend test/post_repository_test.dart and/or new test/feed_pagination_test.dart (pure, no Supabase): (1) keysetMinCursor returns the correct oldest-by-(created_at,id) post for a mixed list incl. equal-created_at tie-break by id, and null for empty; (2) the keyset predicate builder produces the expected `created_at.lt.<iso>,and(created_at.eq.<iso>,id.lt.<id>)` string for a cursor (so loadMore and loadMoreFollowing share verified predicate logic); (3) DE-DUPE: given an existing cache and a mapped page that overlaps by id, the 'fresh' filter drops the overlap and appends only new ids (extract the fresh-filter into a pure helper if needed to test without Supabase); (4) MONOTONIC cursor: chaining keysetMinCursor across two synthetic pages yields strictly-decreasing cursors (compareTo > 0). Add feed_ranking-independent coverage proving the cursor is derived from the keyset tail NOT the ranked tail (e.g. rank with EngagementRanking, confirm keysetMinCursor is unchanged vs chronological). Do NOT weaken existing assertions.

WIDGET-LOGIC TESTS (best-effort, no device) — where feasible without a device/golden, add a widget test for _FeedList footer states using a pumped ListView with a stubbed repository/posts (loading footer appears when a fetch is in flight; end-of-feed footer when !_hasMore; retry footer on error). If a full widget pump is impractical under the test harness, instead extract the footer-state DECISION into a pure function `FeedFooterState footerStateFor({bool loadingMore, bool hasMore, bool hasError, bool isEmpty})` and unit-test THAT exhaustively, and have _FeedList render off it. Document why (no device/golden test infra).

DOCS + VERIFY — update README.md to document the infinity feed: keyset (seek) pagination decoupled from display ranking, prefetch, per-tab following-scoped query, loading/empty/error/end-of-feed states, no-dup/no-drop guarantee. Note in README + findings that the LIVE keyset predicate + the following-scoped `owner in (...)` query + the self-embed join are UNVERIFIED against a live Supabase (env risk) and validated by structural review only. FOLLOW-UP (a) TRUE KEYSET TAIL: Added pure static `PostRepository.keysetMinCursor(List<Post>)` returning the post that sorts LAST under (created_at desc, id desc) — oldest, smallest-id tie-break — or null for empty. `_FeedListState` now keeps a per-tab `FeedCursor? _cursor` seeded from keysetMinCursor of the initial cache and thereafter SET FROM the returned `FeedPage.nextCursor`, passed to the pager instead of `FeedCursor.fromPost(posts.last)`. Display ranking and pagination cursor are now decoupled (documented in feed_page.dart FeedPage.nextCursor doc + README). Proven by a unit test that keysetMinCursor is identical whether the list is ranked with ChronologicalRanking or EngagementRanking (whose display tails differ).

FOLLOW-UP (b) FOLLOWING-SCOPED KEYSET QUERY: Added `Future<FeedPage> loadMoreFollowing(FeedCursor)` applying the SAME keyset predicate PLUS `.inFilter('owner', <followed ids>)`. Followed author ids come from a guarded `_followedAuthorIds()` reading the `follows` table (status=accepted); under the mock/offline path (no Supabase) it returns an empty set so loadMoreFollowing is a no-op returning FeedPage.empty, exactly like loadMore. For You keeps global loadMore. Extracted the keyset predicate into pure static `PostRepository.keysetPredicate(FeedCursor)` shared by both pagers; the append/dedupe/cursor logic is shared in a private `_appendPage`.

INFINITY UX: `_FeedList` prefetches within ~600px of bottom AND kicks an initial post-frame prefetch when the first page under-fills the viewport (maxScrollExtent<=0). In-flight guard `_loadingMore` + per-tab `_hasMore` prevent overlap. Footer decision extracted to pure `footerStateFor({loadingMore,hasMore,hasError,isEmpty})` -> `FeedFooterState` enum (empty/loadingNext/error/endOfFeed/idle), rendered by a new `_FeedFooter` widget: spinner (loading-next), 'You're all caught up' (end-of-feed), inline 'Couldn't load more'+Retry (error), and the existing `_EmptyFeed` now takes a `_FeedKind` for per-tab copy (For You vs Following). StoryRing above the TabBarView unchanged.

ERROR SIGNAL WITHOUT BREAKING NO-THROW: Added `bool error` (default false, const) to FeedPage + a `FeedPage.failure` const (error:true, hasMore:true, empty posts). FeedPage.empty still compiles/const. Added `isSupabaseInitialized` getter to supabase_config.dart so the pager's catch distinguishes an uninitialized-client no-op (tests/offline -> FeedPage.empty) from a real live-client failure (-> FeedPage.failure for the retry footer). Guarded contract preserved: pagers never throw.

NO DUP/NO DROP: Extracted pure static `PostRepository.freshPosts(fetched, existingIds)` for the id-dedupe on append. FeedPage.nextCursor is the keyset tail (mapped.last) — documented as strictly monotonic decreasing across pages in feed_page.dart.

TESTS: New test/feed_pagination_test.dart (pure, no Supabase): keysetMinCursor (oldest, id tie-break, null-empty, order-independent), keysetPredicate exact string + UTC normalization, freshPosts dedupe (partial/all/none overlap), monotonic cursor chaining across two pages (compareTo>0) incl. equal-created_at id tie-break, ranking-independence proof (chrono vs engagement display tails differ but keysetMinCursor identical), footerStateFor exhaustive precedence, FeedPage.empty/failure signalling. Extended test/post_repository_test.dart with offline-path loadMore/loadMoreFollowing returning FeedPage.empty (no throw, cache unchanged). No existing assertion weakened.

ENV RISK (documented in README + not claimed verified): the live keyset `.or(...)` predicate, the following-scoped `owner in (...)` query, the `follows` author-id fetch, and the FEAT-013 self-embed join are UNVERIFIED against a live Supabase (no reachable project) and validated by structural review only. No device/golden test infra, so the footer-state decision is unit-tested as a pure function rather than via a widget pump.

=== REVIEW FOLLOW-UP (v1 semantic review 2026-09-08-160523, verdict APPROVED) ===
Addressed the two non-blocking findings tied to the infinity feed.
FINDING #1 (Following pager fails open to end-of-feed): FIXED. Previously `_followedAuthorIds` swallowed ANY failure into an empty set and `loadMoreFollowing` mapped empty to FeedPage.empty BEFORE its own catch, so a transient `follows` fetch failure looked identical to 'follows nobody' (no Retry). Now `_followedAuthorIds` returns an empty set ONLY when the client is uninitialized (offline/tests, via `isSupabaseInitialized`) or there is no authenticated user; when the client IS initialized and the `follows` query throws, the error is RETHROWN so `loadMoreFollowing`'s catch routes it to `_errorOrEmpty()` producing FeedPage.failure (the retry path). A genuinely-empty follow set still returns FeedPage.empty (correct end-of-feed). Guarded no-throw contract preserved: under `flutter test`/offline the pager still returns FeedPage.empty and never throws (the `!isSupabaseInitialized` early return prevents touching Supabase). TESTS: strengthened the offline Following test to assert error==false (empty, not failure) with a reason; added a 'loadMoreFollowing does not throw and leaves the cache unchanged' no-throw guard; added a 'FeedPage failure-vs-empty distinction' group pinning FeedPage.empty (no error, not hasMore) vs FeedPage.failure (error, hasMore), the two shapes the pager selects between.
FINDING #3 (live query/embed/migration UNVERIFIED): LEFT AS-IS per orchestrator. Inherent env constraint (no reachable Supabase), already documented as the largest known risk in the migration 0010 head comment, README, and task.json findings.
RE-VERIFY: `flutter analyze` => 'No issues found!' (zero); `flutter test` => 260/260 pass (was 257, +3 new). No new pub packages, no migration changes (0001-0010 unchanged), no existing assertion weakened. analysis_options.yaml not modified (no exclude block appeared).
